plugin.name: Activity Link Preview For BuddyPress
plugin.architecture: single-file procedural; no classes, no namespace
plugin.requires: BuddyPress OR BuddyBoss Platform (auto-deactivates if neither active)
plugin.header_version_vs_branch_note: Plugin header + BP_ACTIVITY_LINK_PREVIEW_VERSION + readme Stable tag + package.json all say 1.7.4, matching the v1.7.4 dev branch.

rest.namespace: consumes BuddyPress REST (buddypress/v1) — registers no routes of its own

endpoints.purpose: Embeds bp_activity_link (+ bp_activity_comment_link for comments) preview meta into the BuddyPress activity REST response. Not an own route — a filter on BP's response.

ajax.auth_model: logged-in gate + nonce + SSRF guard (blocks private/internal IPs, localhost, RFC1918 ranges)
ajax.purpose: Fetches Open Graph / oEmbed preview data for a URL typed in the activity composer. Returns title/description/images JSON.

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_link_parse_url_shorten_url_provider
hooks_fired.purpose: Filter the list of short-URL host providers that trigger redirect resolution (bit.ly, tinyurl, etc.).

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_parse_url_preview
hooks_fired.purpose: Filter the parsed preview payload returned by the AJAX handler before JSON output.

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_link_parse_url
hooks_fired.purpose: Filter the final parsed URL data (internal-URL path and external-scrape path both fire it).

hooks_fired.name: bp_oembed_discover_support
hooks_fired.purpose: Toggle oEmbed discovery for a given URL (default false).

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_link_preview_enable_comments
hooks_fired.purpose: Master switch (default true) for comment link previews. Read in localize, save, render, and filter registration paths.

hooks_consumed.name: plugins_loaded
hooks_consumed.purpose: Bootstrap after BP loads (BP uses default 10).

hooks_consumed.name: wp_enqueue_scripts
hooks_consumed.purpose: Enqueue CSS/JS + Twitter + Facebook SDK + localized data.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_init
hooks_consumed.purpose: Remove BuddyBoss's own link preview filter to avoid duplicates.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_init
hooks_consumed.purpose: Register comment-content filter when comment previews enabled.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_activity_after_save
hooks_consumed.purpose: Persist preview data to activity meta on save.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_get_activity_content_body
hooks_consumed.purpose: Append rendered preview to activity content body.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_activity_comment_content
hooks_consumed.purpose: Append rendered preview to comment content (conditionally registered).

hooks_consumed.name: bp_activity_allowed_tags
hooks_consumed.purpose: Allow div/img/button/span/i markup in activity content for previews.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_rest_activity_prepare_value
hooks_consumed.purpose: Embed preview meta into BP REST activity response.

hooks_consumed.name: wp_head
hooks_consumed.purpose: Output #fb-root div on BP activity/group/user pages for Facebook SDK.

activity_meta.purpose: Preview payload (url, title, description, image_url) for main activity posts.

caching.purpose: Cache parsed URL preview data per-URL for 24h.

js_only_activation.note: Composer-time preview UI is JS-only by nature (live URL detection as user types). Render of SAVED previews on read is PHP-side (bp_get_activity_content_body filter), so persisted previews show with JS off. Acceptable.

phpcs_excludes.action: Inline phpcs:ignore/disable at lines 183 (validated URL), 261 (file_get_contents fallback), 602-680 (nonce handled by BP). All justified with comments.

buddypress_integration.compat_notes: Detects and stands down for BuddyBoss native link preview and Youzify wall URL preview to avoid duplicate cards. BuddyBoss JWT (bb-preview-token) used for same-site private-network scrapes.

security.ssrf_guard: AJAX handler blocks empty host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP private/reserved ranges, 127.0.0.1, localhost, and 10./172.16-31./192.168. CIDRs before fetching (bp-activity-link-preview.php:196-204)
security.url_validation: FILTER_VALIDATE_URL on input and on resolved redirect targets
security.remote_fetch: wp_safe_remote_get primary; raw file_get_contents fallback only for short-URL Location header resolution (line 261)
security.output_escaping: esc_attr/esc_url/esc_html in render; oEmbed/embed code passed through (trusted WP oEmbed)

generated.notes: Single-file procedural plugin (1 PHP file). No classes, namespaces, admin pages, settings, CPTs, taxonomies, DB tables, cron, WP-CLI, blocks, or shortcodes. Phase 4.5/4.7/4.8 paired-plugin + CI + cleanup scaffolds intentionally NOT created (onboarding-only run, no functional/scaffold changes per task scope). Coverage gate: all enumerated categories match ground-truth grep exactly (0 gap).
